objects.label: Property
objects.desc: The physical building or land parcel. Hub of the CRE data model: listings, availabilities, leases, sales, deals and inquiries all relate to it.

vrs.name: TC_Year_Built_Range
vrs.msg: Year Built must be between 1800 and five years from now.

vrs.name: TC_Renovated_After_Built
vrs.msg: Year Renovated cannot be before Year Built.

vrs.name: TC_Total_Size_Positive
vrs.msg: Total Size must be greater than zero.

objects.label: Unit Profile
objects.desc: Reusable unit-type template (e.g. a standard office suite or a 2-bed apartment). Named by AscendixRE; fields are TC design.

objects.label: Unit
objects.desc: A leasable unit or suite in a property. Named by AscendixRE; fields are TC design. Drives the stacking plan.

vrs.name: TC_Unit_Size_Positive
vrs.msg: Unit size must be greater than zero.

objects.label: Availability
objects.desc: A vacant unit or suite in a property that is on the market. Status becomes Closed when the related deal closes.

vrs.name: TC_Min_Divisible_Within_Size
vrs.msg: Min Divisible cannot be larger than the available Size.

vrs.name: TC_Unit_Same_Property
vrs.msg: The selected Unit belongs to a different Property.

vrs.name: TC_Size_Positive
vrs.msg: Size must be greater than zero.

objects.label: Listing
objects.desc: The listing agreement a broker holds to lease or sell a property. Anchor for marketing and inbound inquiries.

vrs.name: TC_Expiration_After_Listing_Date
vrs.msg: Expiration Date must be after the Listing Date.

vrs.name: TC_Active_Sale_Requires_Price
vrs.msg: An active Sale listing needs an Asking Price.

vrs.name: TC_Active_Lease_Requires_Rate
vrs.msg: An active Lease listing needs an Asking Rate.

objects.label: Deal
objects.desc: A brokerage revenue opportunity, typed by business line (12 record types). Closing a deal as Won can create a Lease, Sale or Listing.

vrs.name: TC_Lost_Reason_Required
vrs.msg: Choose a Lost Reason when closing a deal as Lost.

vrs.name: TC_Close_Date_Not_Future
vrs.msg: Actual Close Date cannot be in the future.

vrs.name: TC_Gross_Fee_Rate_per_UOM
vrs.msg: The $ per SF fee method needs both Size and Gross Fee Rate per SF.

vrs.name: TC_Per_SF_Fee_Lease_Deals_Only
vrs.msg: The $ per SF fee method is only available for Tenant and Landlord Representation deals.

vrs.name: TC_Lease_Expiration_After_Commencement
vrs.msg: Lease Expiration must be after Lease Commencement.

vrs.name: TC_Percent_Method_Requires_Percent
vrs.msg: Enter the Gross Fee Percent before closing the deal as Won.

objects.label: Deal Period
objects.desc: One row of the rent table on a Deal.

vrs.name: TC_Period_End_After_Start
vrs.msg: The period end date (To) must be on or after the start date (From).

vrs.name: TC_Prevent_Blank_Rate_And_Rent
vrs.msg: Enter a Rate or a Rent Per Month, or mark the period as Free Rent.

objects.label: Lease
objects.desc: Lease abstract: a tenant occupying space in a property. Serves as a lease comp and drives expiration prospecting.

vrs.name: TC_Expiration_After_Commencement
vrs.msg: Expiration Date must be after Commencement Date.

vrs.name: TC_Unit_Same_Property
vrs.msg: The selected Unit belongs to a different Property.

vrs.name: TC_Option_Notice_Before_Expiration
vrs.msg: Option Notice Date must be before the Expiration Date.

vrs.name: TC_Size_Positive
vrs.msg: Size must be greater than zero.

objects.label: Lease Period
objects.desc: One row of the rent table on a Lease. Copied from the Deal when the deal closes, or generated from the lease terms.

vrs.name: TC_Period_End_After_Start
vrs.msg: The period end date (To) must be on or after the start date (From).

vrs.name: TC_Prevent_Blank_Rate_And_Rent
vrs.msg: Enter a Rate or a Rent Per Month, or mark the period as Free Rent.

objects.label: Sale
objects.desc: A property's sale history (sale comps). Created when a Buyer or Seller Representation deal closes as Won, or entered as a comp.

vrs.name: TC_Sale_Price_Positive
vrs.msg: Sale Price must be greater than zero.

objects.label: Inquiry
objects.desc: An unqualified lead about leasing or buying space, arriving by phone, email, portal or web form. Converts to Account, Contact and Deal.

vrs.name: TC_Size_Max_Above_Min
vrs.msg: Size Max must be greater than or equal to Size Min.

vrs.name: TC_Price_Max_Above_Min
vrs.msg: Price Max must be greater than or equal to Price Min.

vrs.name: TC_Disqualified_Reason_Required
vrs.msg: Choose a Disqualified Reason.

vrs.name: TC_Contact_Info_Required
vrs.msg: Enter the inquirer's Last Name or pick an existing Contact.

objects.label: Prospective Listing
objects.desc: Links an Inquiry to the Listings proposed to it. One may be marked Primary; shown on the Listing as Prospective Inquiries.

objects.label: Prospective Buyer
objects.desc: A potential buyer on a Seller Representation deal. The primary buyer fills the Deal Buyer fields.

objects.label: Offer
objects.desc: An offer received on a Landlord or Seller Representation deal. AscendixRE documents offer tracking but not its fields.

objects.label: Commission
objects.desc: A share of a deal fee: inside broker, analyst, co-broker or expense.

vrs.name: TC_Inside_Broker_Requires_User
vrs.msg: Choose the Broker (User) for an Inside Broker commission.

vrs.name: TC_Co_Broker_Requires_Party
vrs.msg: Choose an Account or Contact for this commission.

vrs.name: TC_Amount_Method_Requires_Amount
vrs.msg: Enter a Fee Amount when the Fee Method is Amount.

vrs.name: TC_Percent_Method_Requires_Percent
vrs.msg: Enter a Fee Percent when the Fee Method is Percent.

vrs.name: TC_Paid_Requires_Date
vrs.msg: Enter the Paid Date when marking a commission as Paid.

objects.label: Capital Source
objects.desc: A lender or capital provider. Lending criteria fields are TC design.

vrs.name: TC_Max_Deal_Size_Above_Min
vrs.msg: Max Deal Size must be greater than or equal to Min Deal Size.

objects.label: Deal Source
objects.desc: A capital source interested in lending on a Capital Markets deal.

objects.label: Term Sheet
objects.desc: A lender quote under a Deal Source; compared side by side on the deal.

objects.label: Deal Property
objects.desc: Links several properties to one Capital Markets deal (Multiple Properties).

objects.label: Relationship
objects.desc: Links a record to an internal user in a named role (relationship grid). Extend by adding lookups.

vrs.name: TC_User_Required
vrs.msg: Choose the internal User for this relationship.

objects.label: Market Rent
objects.desc: Market rent benchmark by market, property type and class. Named by AscendixRE; fields are TC design.

vrs.name: TC_High_Rate_Above_Low
vrs.msg: High Rate must be greater than or equal to Low Rate.
